waivers.reason: Audited: the trigger is the unprivileged PR event, so the job runs in the fork context with contents: read and no secrets. head.sha is a hex digest passed through env: into git diff and cannot carry a payload. Rule refinement tracked in #90.
waivers.author: TGPSKI

waivers.reason: Audited: the checkout step sets no ref:, so the privileged PR trigger checks out the base commit rather than PR head. sparse-checkout is limited to CODEOWNERS and OWNERS, permissions grant only pull-requests: write, and the PR author reaches the script through env:. No PR-authored code executes. Rule refinement tracked in #90.
waivers.author: TGPSKI

waivers.reason: False positive: the match is the subject-path input of actions/attest-build-provenance, which names files to attest, not an OIDC subject claim. Rule refinement tracked in #91.
waivers.author: TGPSKI

waivers.reason: Audited and accepted: the release job needs contents: write to create the release and id-token: write to attest the archives with Sigstore. It is workflow_dispatch-only and gated on CODEOWNERS membership, so no untrusted input reaches it. Attesting without both permissions is not possible (#4).
